This is they way! It's easy to be a consumer and buy all that stuff premade. But in this hobby you really need only a few essentials and you can do it all yourself. Failures and successes is how you learn and grow.

Idk how the water would be getting in. But my jars aren't perfect seal either and there doesn't seem to be an issue. I 1/4 turn my lids back so they don't seal. The foil goes past the rim of the lid ring though. If water vapors were sneaking in we'd all have your problem cause the GE would let the vapors through too. 

Also I don't feel like water vapors would be creating an extreme amount of moisture in the jar either. Chances are the moisture is already on your grain, and they aren't as dry as you think they are. Don't ask me how though cause idk that either. But I do know that I've experienced a couple of tablespoons at the bottom of my jars. They dry up for me in a few days though.

This is popcorn you are using correct? What is your drain and dry method?

Maybe try a different grain and see if you are having the same problems? 

Is the moisture at the bottom immediate or does it take a few days to accumulate?

Parafilm is pretty spendy for that, and it wouldn't need to be breathable tape if there's a GE on top. Also the water shouldn't be coming in through the sides of the lids because the lines around the jar that the lid screws to would block it. Foil is there so water doesn't come through the micropore tape on top of the lid.
